question:
You are helping Hamza, who runs a manufacturing company near Marrakech. Here is what they told you, in their own order.
The company is choosing among 5 improvement projects, labelled P1 to P5.
A competitor opened a new site in Casablanca 8 months ago.
Each project is either done in full or not at all. Cost and expected yearly benefit:

| Project | Cost (dollars) | Yearly benefit (dollars) |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 18,000 | 26,000 |
| P2 | 15,000 | 13,000 |
| P3 | 85,000 | 79,000 |
| P4 | 39,000 | 52,000 |
| P5 | 88,000 | 79,000 |

Hamza, who manages the site, has 18 years of experience.
The annual safety inspection last took place 7 months ago and found no issues.
The total budget is 92,000 dollars.
Last year's total revenue was 5,882,000 dollars.
Which projects should be funded to maximise the total yearly benefit?
answer_keys: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
objective_key: The maximum total yearly benefit in dollars
